council_map.vintage: Unknown. A search result says the city code (amlegal, section on councilmanic districts) cites Ord. 2002-1496 passed 10-7-2002; that page is behind a Cloudflare challenge and was not saved. No current map found.
council_map.notes: The city website www.martinsville.in.gov, the amlegal code and ecode360 all answered scripted requests with a Cloudflare block (403); I did not try to get around it. Morgan County pages that could list the map returned 404.

notes: The city's own site could not be read (Cloudflare block), so every name comes from state records: the SBOA audit (mayor, clerk) and the Secretary of State 2023 candidate list (council, five district seats and two at-large candidates). Council size 7 (5 district + 2 at large) is inferred from five district nominees and two at-large nominees, plus a search-result summary from a chamber page that said 'five members elected by district and two at-large' (page not saved; its URL 404s now). Treat all council rows as NEEDING a 2026 check (resignations and caucus replacements would not appear). City court: Martinsville City Court, judge E. Grace Terrell per the state directory (raw/peru-in/court-directory.pdf); 2023 nominee for city judge was Mark Peden - the two differ, so the judge is unclear; out of scope.
